Check core, data and scene physics on wasm

jobs.name: The two wasm halves, together
successful_steps: Build the bench for the browser
Solve in the browser and compare
verified_markers: ok   a bare bench admits it cannot solve
ok   and reports a miss rather than inventing an answer
ok   with IPhreeqc attached, the bench can solve
ok   a state nobody pre-computed is now solved
ok   the pH is a real number
ok   browser and desktop agree on pH
ok   browser and desktop agree on ionic strength
ok   the species distribution came across
ok   the live R1 report uses schema 1
ok   all five R1 scenarios solve through live browser IPhreeqc

scope: Own-source core/data/scene WASM compilation and completed browser-engine bridge only. Bridge checks absent-solver refusal, live solution, desktop/browser pH agreement below 1e-6 and ionic strength agreement below 1e-9, species transport, and five live R1 scenarios. Ordinary hosted lock and built binary are uncaptured; no local/fleet lock borrowed. Not general empirical chemical accuracy or full workflow acceptance.
